statements.proposition: This change introduces no breaking changes: existing TensorFlow-backend functionality behaves as before.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Partly checked, not settled. Without stat_file the TF path is unchanged (new stat_file_path kwarg defaults to None; _compute_output_stat falls through to the original call). But the base already accepted stat_file for all backends (argcheck only had a PT-only doc note) and TF ignored it; now a TF config that already contains stat_file creates a directory/h5 file and computes energy bias via a new function (PR text itself says bias differs by ~1e-4). Whether that counts as breaking is a judgment. Also PairTabModel.data_stat(self, data) was not given the new kwarg while Trainer.build now calls data_stat(data, stat_file_path=...); PairTabModel appears to be used only inside linear models (which call data_stat(data) without the kwarg), so no concrete break was demonstrated. PR was closed, not merged.
